description: Shared ML/AI Engineering course resource registry for TomorrowAI Command Center, Pulse, and Cursor/Codex workflows.

resources.name: AI Engineering from Scratch
resources.role: Build-from-scratch reinforcement, artifact generation, MCP/agent/LLM engineering depth track.
do_not_use_for: forcing completion of all phases before shipping
blocking daily build progress with excessive reading
resources.activation_rule: Use when today's Pulse or Command Center build needs from-scratch reinforcement, agent/MCP depth, or a portfolio-grade artifact.

surface_usage.command_center: Show as a Tier 1 build-depth resource in the strategic ML Course dashboard.
surface_usage.pulse: Show only when it supports today's build task or checkpoint.
surface_usage.cursor: Use to generate implementation tasks and artifacts.

resources.name: Microsoft ML-For-Beginners
resources.role: Classic machine learning fundamentals and remediation resource.
use_for: remediation when ML basics block AI engineering progress
resources.activation_rule: Use only when a classical ML concept is blocking the active AI engineering build or checkpoint.

surface_usage.command_center: Show as a Tier 2 support/remediation resource.
surface_usage.pulse: Show only as support if today's task exposes a fundamentals gap.
surface_usage.cursor: Use for small review tasks, not main build tasks.
